findings.message: 1 line in "Shaking now: Drop, Cover and Hold" has no quote from the guideline ("As soon as the shaking stops, tap Next."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.

1 line in "Not sure if it was long or strong" has no quote from the guideline ("The guidance doesn't say what to do if you're not sure."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Can't walk, or have to drive" has no quote from the guideline ("The guidance says nothing more for people who can't walk,…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Stay at sea" has no quote from the guideline ("The guidance says nothing more for small boats at sea."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "If your property is damaged" has no quote from the guideline ("The guidance does not say when a damaged building is safe…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
